card.name: The word Online in titles and URLs
card.fires_on: The word "online" (or sometimes "Global") when it sits in a web address, site name, or page title, such as "MedTerms online medical dictionary" or "The Online Books Page".

modes.label: Online in site names
modes.description: "Online" as part of a resource or page title, often right after "The" or "MedTerms".

modes.label: Online in a URL
modes.description: "online" as the host label in a web address.

modes.label: Global in site names
modes.description: "Global" as the first word of a site or section name.

card.writes: It pushes toward slash-path and scope-style pieces like /local, /global and /int, which suggests a web or code address continuing.
card.plain: It marks the word "online" or "global" when it is part of the name of a website or web page.
